name: create_todo
description: Create a new TODO item in a named calendar.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar to create the todo in.

due.description: Optional due date as ISO 8601. A bare datetime (e.g. 2026-09-28T21:00:00) is interpreted in the selected timezone; an offset datetime (e.g. 2026-09-28T21:00:00+03:00) is converted to it. A date (e.g. 2026-09-28) creates an all-day due date.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name (e.g. Europe/Athens) overriding the configured default_timezone for bare datetimes.

description.description: Optional longer description of the todo.

priority.description: Optional priority from 0 (undefined) to 9 per RFC 5545, where 1 is highest.
